scope: Assigned scenario budgets, not tokenized text, native usage, typical costs or measured policy gains. Logical teaching load order is not captured native serialization.
observedLimits: Six recorded runs across different arms/tasks. Peak inputs are per-run maxima; not a matched managed-vs-uncurated estimate. Complete native/provider prompts were not retained.

platform.label: Platform monorepo
platform.files: Several packages, shared contracts and organization guidance

org.label: Large organization workflow
org.files: Many packages and shared skills; broader repository discovery

layers.label: Harness + model instructions
layers.detail: Instruction allowance held constant in both paths. Exact hidden provider instructions and native system prompts were not captured; this is an assumption, not a reconstructed prompt.

layers.label: Tool definitions + contracts
layers.detail: Schemas and tool contracts held constant. No required tool definitions are removed by the managed policy. Tool results are counted separately in history.

layers.label: Applicable AGENTS.md guidance
layers.detail: Global, organization, repository and workspace guidance as applicable to the chosen harness. Preserve all required rules in documented native order; arbitrary nested files are not all automatically loaded.

layers.label: Skill catalog + invoked bodies
layers.detail: Both paths include a 700-token catalog allowance. Uncurated workflow explicitly invokes/pastes 6000 tokens of skill bodies; managed workflow invokes 1800 relevant tokens. Native discovery is not assumed to load every skill body automatically.

layers.label: Current task + acceptance
layers.detail: Same task, constraints and acceptance requirements in both paths. Turn 2 adds a 500-token follow-up allowance. No task requirement is dropped.

layers.label: Selected repository evidence
layers.detail: Uncurated workflow reads broad package material; managed workflow selects dependency-relevant files/contracts. Full artifacts remain retrievable. Amounts are scenario assumptions.

layers.label: Conversation + tool results
layers.detail: Selected messages and tool output. Each event adds its own authored allowance only after that output exists. Managed path bounds/summarizes returned material; no quality or accuracy gain is measured.

layers.label: Checkpoint + source anchors
layers.detail: Both paths compact at the same teaching boundary. Uncurated checkpoint gets a 6000-token allowance; managed checkpoint gets 2000 with required facts/anchors and a restoration check. This is not measured summary quality or native trigger timing.
